title: artemisia glauca var. cernua
intro: Artemisia glauca var. cernua, commonly known as Upland Sagebrush, is a shrubby perennial plant native to the mountainous regions of western North America. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and exerting antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Upland Sagebrush are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include essential oils such as borneol, camphor, and thujone, as well as flavonoids and phenolic acids. The health benefits of Upland Sagebrush include its potential to alleviate symptoms associated with colds, fever, and respiratory infections, making it a valuable herb in traditional medicine.
